integrity: The universal identity is proved by an exact distance-to-supporting-hyperplane construction. The Radon lower bound follows from the contractivity of the Birkhoff-orthogonal projection, and the hexagonal sharpness uses explicit continuum witness families. The bundled checker verifies the finite polar/support geometry and sampled witnesses; finite sampling is not used as proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The eta=upsilon identity is universal for real Banach spaces. The lower bound max(0,epsilon-1) assumes symmetric Birkhoff orthogonality, and exact sharpness is proved only for the affine-regular hexagonal plane. No classification of all Radon-plane profiles or all maximizers is claimed.
title: Collapse of the auxiliary strong-rotundity index and the affine-regular hexagon profile
